backlogged.summary: The AC-2 criterion text writes the brief format as 'todo N (v1 partial P · blocked B)'. The implementation keeps the existing 'N todo' order, giving 'N todo (v1 partial P · blocked B)', and SPEC §13 and README use that order too. The contract wording and the output differ only in word order, so the contract text could be aligned in a later version.

The --brief split counts only partial and blocked, following the contract. in_progress and deferred v1 features are folded into the unsplit remainder, so an in_progress v1 feature (arguably the most 'started' kind) is not highlighted in the SessionStart brief.

Nothing tests the in_progress group in `status --todo-v1`. The fixtures cover the partial, blocked, deferred and no-state groups but not in_progress, so the group ordering for in_progress is checked only by reading the code.
The CLI help and usage text do not mention the new `status --todo-v1` flag; it is documented only in README and SPEC §13.
